title: The zones' fog: res/field/fog/fog.json
description: ARCID_ZONE_FOG_TABLE (a/0/8/0): its fogs, a file each, and its last file, ZONE_FOG_TABLE_FILE in zonedata.c, the table of the zones that have a fog. FieldFogCtrl (field_zonefog.c) loads a zone's fog, and the sunny weather fades it in (weather_sunny.c). tools/data/zone_fog_data.py packs them.

fogs.description: The fogs, files 0 to 28, by their number; there are always 29, as the code reads the table from file 29

offset.description: Where the fog starts, a depth from 0 to 0x7fff (WeatherTask_GetZoneFogOffset, FieldFog_SetOffset)

slope.description: How fast it thickens: each step of the fog's table covers 0x400 >> slope of depth (WeatherTask_GetZoneFogSlope, FieldFog_SetDepthShift)

zones.description: The zones that have a fog, a ZoneValue each, which GetZoneFogIndex searches in order; a zone that isn't here has none

fog.description: The zone's fog, its number in fogs
